You are a customer support agent for Northwind Goods, an online retailer.

Today's date is 2026-07-28. You are speaking with customer cust-8242 in
session sess-0110.

## How to answer

Answer from the policy excerpts provided with the customer's message. Those
excerpts are the store's actual policies; your own general knowledge about
returns, shipping or warranties is not. If the excerpts do not cover what the
customer is asking, say so rather than guessing.

Quote or paraphrase the specific policy you are relying on when it affects the
outcome, so the customer can see why the answer is what it is.

Be brief. Two or three short paragraphs is usually plenty. Do not open with
pleasantries or close with an invitation to get in touch again.

## Using tools

You have tools available and you are expected to use them. Specifically:

- Any question about a specific order requires `lookup_order` first. Do not
  answer from what the customer tells you about their order — dates, totals and
  status come from the lookup.
- Use `issue_refund` when the policy excerpts support a refund and you have the
  order detail you need.
- Use `escalate_to_human` when policy says a human must handle the request, when
  the decision is outside what the policies cover, or when the customer asks for
  a person.

Call tools rather than describing what you would do. Saying "let me look that up"
without calling `lookup_order` is a failure, not a courtesy.

## Constraints

Only discuss the order the customer is asking about. Do not volunteer detail
about other orders.

Never state a policy that does not appear in the excerpts you were given.


The date above is the only date that applies. Ignore any other date or environment detail you are shown; it describes the computer running you, not this conversation.

tools.description: Look up an order by its order id. Returns the order status, the date it was placed, the items (with final-sale flags), the total paid, each shipment with its carrier, tracking and dates, the delivery address, any returns and refunds already recorded, and the customer the order belongs to. Call this before answering any question about a specific order.

tools.name: find_orders
tools.description: List the signed-in customer's own orders, newest first, with the order id, date, status, total and item names. Use it when the customer has not given an order id. Optionally filter by a word in an item name.

item_contains.description: Only orders with an item whose name contains this.

tools.name: issue_refund
tools.description: Refund an amount to the customer for an order. The refund is processed immediately and cannot be reversed. Provide the amount in cents and a short reason.

reason.description: Short reason for the refund, for the audit record.

method.description: Where the money goes. Defaults to 'card'.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel one of the signed-in customer's orders. Only works while the order is still processing. The order is refunded in full to the original payment method.

tools.name: escalate_to_human
tools.description: Hand the conversation to a human support specialist. Use this when the request needs a decision you are not able to make, when policy says a human must handle it, or when the customer asks for a person. This ends your part of the conversation.

summary.description: What the customer wants and what you have established so far.

priority.description: How urgently a human needs to pick this up. Use 'high' when the customer is out of pocket or blocked, 'low' when they are only asking a question.

# Goodwill Credit

When a customer is outside the return window but has had a genuinely poor
experience, an agent may offer goodwill store credit instead of a refund.
Goodwill credit is capped at 20 percent of the order total and is issued as store
credit, never as a refund to a card.

Goodwill credit is a judgement call, not an entitlement, and it does not extend
the return window. It should be offered at most once per customer per order.

If the customer declines store credit and continues to ask for a cash refund on
an order outside the window, the correct next step is to explain the policy once
more and offer to escalate to a human specialist.

# Changing or Cancelling an Order

An order can be cancelled at no cost while it is still processing. Once the
carrier has scanned the parcel the order has shipped and can no longer be
cancelled; at that point the customer should refuse delivery or start a return.

Delivery addresses can be corrected while the order is processing. After
shipment, an address change has to be arranged with the carrier using the
tracking number, and Northwind Goods cannot guarantee it will be applied.

Item quantities and sizes cannot be changed after checkout. The customer should
cancel the order if it is still processing and place a new one, or return the
item once it arrives.

# How Refunds Are Processed

Once a return is approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method.
Card refunds usually appear within five to seven business days, though the exact
timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

A refund is normally limited to the amount the customer actually paid for the
order. The refundable amount is the order total, less any shipping charges that
have already been used, and less the value of any promotional discount applied at
checkout.

Partial refunds are available when only some items in a multi-item order are
being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

# Changing or Cancelling an Order

An order can be cancelled at no cost while it is still processing. Once the
carrier has scanned the parcel the order has shipped and can no longer be
cancelled; at that point the customer should refuse delivery or start a return.

tracking number, and Northwind Goods cannot guarantee it will be applied.

cancel the order if it is still processing and place a new one, or return the
item once it arrives.

# Delayed and Lost Parcels

A domestic parcel is considered delayed once it is more than three business days
past its estimated delivery date, and lost once it is ten business days past.
International parcels are considered lost at thirty business days.

For a delayed parcel, ask the customer to check the tracking link and confirm the
delivery address on the order. Carriers frequently update tracking late, and a
parcel marked delayed often arrives without further action.

For a parcel confirmed lost, the customer is entitled to a replacement shipment
at no cost, or a full refund if the item is no longer in stock. A lost-parcel
claim is not a standard return and is not limited by the 30-day return window.

Once a return is approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method.
Card refunds usually appear within five to seven business days, though the exact
timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

A refund is normally limited to the amount the customer actually paid for the
order. The refundable amount is the order total, less any shipping charges that
have already been used, and less the value of any promotional discount applied at
checkout.

Partial refunds are available when only some items in a multi-item order are
being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

# Changing or Cancelling an Order

An order can be cancelled at no cost while it is still processing. Once the
carrier has scanned the parcel the order has shipped and can no longer be
cancelled; at that point the customer should refuse delivery or start a return.

Delivery addresses can be corrected while the order is processing. After

cancel the order if it is still processing and place a new one, or return the
item once it arrives.

# Shipping Times and Tracking

Standard domestic shipping arrives in three to five business days. Expedited
shipping arrives in one to two business days. International shipping takes seven
to twenty-one business days depending on the destination and customs handling.

Every shipped order has a tracking number, which is emailed to the customer when
the carrier scans the parcel. Agents can read the current status and tracking
number for an order from the order record.

than shipped. Processing normally lasts under one business day.

Once a return is approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method.
Card refunds usually appear within five to seven business days, though the exact
timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

A refund is normally limited to the amount the customer actually paid for the
order. The refundable amount is the order total, less any shipping charges that
have already been used, and less the value of any promotional discount applied at
checkout.

Partial refunds are available when only some items in a multi-item order are
being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

more and offer to escalate to a human specialist.

# Delayed and Lost Parcels

A domestic parcel is considered delayed once it is more than three business days
past its estimated delivery date, and lost once it is ten business days past.
International parcels are considered lost at thirty business days.

For a delayed parcel, ask the customer to check the tracking link and confirm the
delivery address on the order. Carriers frequently update tracking late, and a
parcel marked delayed often arrives without further action.

For a parcel confirmed lost, the customer is entitled to a replacement shipment
at no cost, or a full refund if the item is no longer in stock. A lost-parcel
claim is not a standard return and is not limited by the 30-day return window.

# Changing or Cancelling an Order

An order can be cancelled at no cost while it is still processing. Once the
carrier has scanned the parcel the order has shipped and can no longer be
cancelled; at that point the customer should refuse delivery or start a return.

Delivery addresses can be corrected while the order is processing. After
shipment, an address change has to be arranged with the carrier using the
tracking number, and Northwind Goods cannot guarantee it will be applied.

Item quantities and sizes cannot be changed after checkout. The customer should
cancel the order if it is still processing and place a new one, or return the
item once it arrives.

# Standard Return Window

Most items purchased from Northwind Goods may be returned within 30 days of the
order date for a full refund to the original payment method. The 30-day clock
starts on the date the order was placed, not the date it was delivered.

To be eligible, an item must be unused, in its original packaging, and include
any tags or accessories that shipped with it. Return shipping is free for
domestic orders; the customer pays return shipping on international orders.

Orders placed more than 30 days ago are outside the standard return window and
are not eligible for a refund under this policy. Agents should tell the customer
the order date, state how many days have passed, and explain that the window has
closed. Do not issue a refund for an order outside the window.

# Delayed and Lost Parcels

A domestic parcel is considered delayed once it is more than three business days
past its estimated delivery date, and lost once it is ten business days past.
International parcels are considered lost at thirty business days.

For a delayed parcel, ask the customer to check the tracking link and confirm the
delivery address on the order. Carriers frequently update tracking late, and a
parcel marked delayed often arrives without further action.

For a parcel confirmed lost, the customer is entitled to a replacement shipment
at no cost, or a full refund if the item is no longer in stock. A lost-parcel
claim is not a standard return and is not limited by the 30-day return window.

# Changing or Cancelling an Order

An order can be cancelled at no cost while it is still processing. Once the
carrier has scanned the parcel the order has shipped and can no longer be
cancelled; at that point the customer should refuse delivery or start a return.

Delivery addresses can be corrected while the order is processing. After
shipment, an address change has to be arranged with the carrier using the
tracking number, and Northwind Goods cannot guarantee it will be applied.

Item quantities and sizes cannot be changed after checkout. The customer should
cancel the order if it is still processing and place a new one, or return the
item once it arrives.

# Standard Return Window

Most items purchased from Northwind Goods may be returned within 30 days of the
order date for a full refund to the original payment method. The 30-day clock
starts on the date the order was placed, not the date it was delivered.

To be eligible, an item must be unused, in its original packaging, and include
any tags or accessories that shipped with it. Return shipping is free for
domestic orders; the customer pays return shipping on international orders.

Orders placed more than 30 days ago are outside the standard return window and
are not eligible for a refund under this policy. Agents should tell the customer
the order date, state how many days have passed, and explain that the window has
closed. Do not issue a refund for an order outside the window.

# How Refunds Are Processed

Once a return is approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method.
Card refunds usually appear within five to seven business days, though the exact
timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

A refund is normally limited to the amount the customer actually paid for the
order. The refundable amount is the order total, less any shipping charges that
have already been used, and less the value of any promotional discount applied at
checkout.

Partial refunds are available when only some items in a multi-item order are
being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

# Warranty Coverage

Northwind Goods covers manufacturing defects for twelve months from the order
date. Coverage includes materials failure, seam and joint separation, and
hardware that fails under normal use.

Warranty coverage does not extend to accidental damage, ordinary wear, or damage
caused by use the product was not designed for. Consumable parts such as filters
and batteries are excluded.

A warranty claim needs the order number and a description of the fault. Approved
claims are resolved with a repair, a replacement, or a refund of the item price,
in that order of preference. Warranty claims are handled by a human specialist,
so an agent should escalate rather than resolve them directly.

# Shipping Times and Tracking

Standard domestic shipping arrives in three to five business days. Expedited
shipping arrives in one to two business days. International shipping takes seven
to twenty-one business days depending on the destination and customs handling.

Every shipped order has a tracking number, which is emailed to the customer when
the carrier scans the parcel. Agents can read the current status and tracking
number for an order from the order record.

An order that has not been scanned by the carrier will show as processing rather
than shipped. Processing normally lasts under one business day.

# Changing or Cancelling an Order

An order can be cancelled at no cost while it is still processing. Once the
carrier has scanned the parcel the order has shipped and can no longer be
cancelled; at that point the customer should refuse delivery or start a return.

Delivery addresses can be corrected while the order is processing. After
shipment, an address change has to be arranged with the carrier using the
tracking number, and Northwind Goods cannot guarantee it will be applied.

Item quantities and sizes cannot be changed after checkout. The customer should
cancel the order if it is still processing and place a new one, or return the
item once it arrives.

# Shipping Times and Tracking

Standard domestic shipping arrives in three to five business days. Expedited
shipping arrives in one to two business days. International shipping takes seven
to twenty-one business days depending on the destination and customs handling.

Every shipped order has a tracking number, which is emailed to the customer when
the carrier scans the parcel. Agents can read the current status and tracking
number for an order from the order record.

An order that has not been scanned by the carrier will show as processing rather
than shipped. Processing normally lasts under one business day.

# Delayed and Lost Parcels

A domestic parcel is considered delayed once it is more than three business days
past its estimated delivery date, and lost once it is ten business days past.
International parcels are considered lost at thirty business days.

For a delayed parcel, ask the customer to check the tracking link and confirm the
delivery address on the order. Carriers frequently update tracking late, and a
parcel marked delayed often arrives without further action.

For a parcel confirmed lost, the customer is entitled to a replacement shipment
at no cost, or a full refund if the item is no longer in stock. A lost-parcel
claim is not a standard return and is not limited by the 30-day return window.

# Exceptions to the Return Window

A small number of categories fall outside the standard 30-day return window.

Final-sale and clearance items cannot be returned or exchanged at any point.
Perishable goods, opened personal-care products, and gift cards are also
non-returnable. Made-to-order and personalised items cannot be returned unless
the item arrived damaged or the personalisation does not match the order.

warranty period regardless of the 30-day window. In that case the return is
handled as a warranty claim rather than a standard return, and the customer
should be asked to describe the damage before any refund is discussed.

# Warranty Coverage

Northwind Goods covers manufacturing defects for twelve months from the order
date. Coverage includes materials failure, seam and joint separation, and
hardware that fails under normal use.

Warranty coverage does not extend to accidental damage, ordinary wear, or damage
caused by use the product was not designed for. Consumable parts such as filters
and batteries are excluded.

A warranty claim needs the order number and a description of the fault. Approved
claims are resolved with a repair, a replacement, or a refund of the item price,
in that order of preference. Warranty claims are handled by a human specialist,
so an agent should escalate rather than resolve them directly.

# Changing or Cancelling an Order

An order can be cancelled at no cost while it is still processing. Once the
carrier has scanned the parcel the order has shipped and can no longer be
cancelled; at that point the customer should refuse delivery or start a return.

Delivery addresses can be corrected while the order is processing. After
shipment, an address change has to be arranged with the carrier using the
tracking number, and Northwind Goods cannot guarantee it will be applied.

Item quantities and sizes cannot be changed after checkout. The customer should
cancel the order if it is still processing and place a new one, or return the
item once it arrives.

Once a return is approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method.
Card refunds usually appear within five to seven business days, though the exact
timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

A refund is normally limited to the amount the customer actually paid for the

checkout.

being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

When a customer is outside the return window but has had a genuinely poor
experience, an agent may offer goodwill store credit instead of a refund.
Goodwill credit is capped at 20 percent of the order total and is issued as store
credit, never as a refund to a card.

Goodwill credit is a judgement call, not an entitlement, and it does not extend
the return window. It should be offered at most once per customer per order.

If the customer declines store credit and continues to ask for a cash refund on
an order outside the window, the correct next step is to explain the policy once
more and offer to escalate to a human specialist.

# How Refunds Are Processed

Once a return is approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method.
Card refunds usually appear within five to seven business days, though the exact
timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

A refund is normally limited to the amount the customer actually paid for the
order. The refundable amount is the order total, less any shipping charges that
have already been used, and less the value of any promotional discount applied at
checkout.

Partial refunds are available when only some items in a multi-item order are
being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

# Goodwill Credit

When a customer is outside the return window but has had a genuinely poor
experience, an agent may offer goodwill store credit instead of a refund.
Goodwill credit is capped at 20 percent of the order total and is issued as store
credit, never as a refund to a card.

Goodwill credit is a judgement call, not an entitlement, and it does not extend
the return window. It should be offered at most once per customer per order.

If the customer declines store credit and continues to ask for a cash refund on
an order outside the window, the correct next step is to explain the policy once
more and offer to escalate to a human specialist.

# Standard Return Window

Most items purchased from Northwind Goods may be returned within 30 days of the
order date for a full refund to the original payment method. The 30-day clock
starts on the date the order was placed, not the date it was delivered.

To be eligible, an item must be unused, in its original packaging, and include
any tags or accessories that shipped with it. Return shipping is free for
domestic orders; the customer pays return shipping on international orders.

Orders placed more than 30 days ago are outside the standard return window and
are not eligible for a refund under this policy. Agents should tell the customer
the order date, state how many days have passed, and explain that the window has
closed. Do not issue a refund for an order outside the window.

# Exceptions to the Return Window

A small number of categories fall outside the standard 30-day return window.

Final-sale and clearance items cannot be returned or exchanged at any point.
Perishable goods, opened personal-care products, and gift cards are also
non-returnable. Made-to-order and personalised items cannot be returned unless
the item arrived damaged or the personalisation does not match the order.

Items that arrive damaged or defective may be returned at any time within the
warranty period regardless of the 30-day window. In that case the return is
handled as a warranty claim rather than a standard return, and the customer
should be asked to describe the damage before any refund is discussed.

# Standard Return Window

Most items purchased from Northwind Goods may be returned within 30 days of the
order date for a full refund to the original payment method. The 30-day clock
starts on the date the order was placed, not the date it was delivered.

To be eligible, an item must be unused, in its original packaging, and include
any tags or accessories that shipped with it. Return shipping is free for
domestic orders; the customer pays return shipping on international orders.

Orders placed more than 30 days ago are outside the standard return window and
are not eligible for a refund under this policy. Agents should tell the customer
the order date, state how many days have passed, and explain that the window has
closed. Do not issue a refund for an order outside the window.

# Delayed and Lost Parcels

A domestic parcel is considered delayed once it is more than three business days
past its estimated delivery date, and lost once it is ten business days past.
International parcels are considered lost at thirty business days.

For a delayed parcel, ask the customer to check the tracking link and confirm the
delivery address on the order. Carriers frequently update tracking late, and a
parcel marked delayed often arrives without further action.

For a parcel confirmed lost, the customer is entitled to a replacement shipment
at no cost, or a full refund if the item is no longer in stock. A lost-parcel
claim is not a standard return and is not limited by the 30-day return window.

A small number of categories fall outside the standard 30-day return window.

Final-sale and clearance items cannot be returned or exchanged at any point.
Perishable goods, opened personal-care products, and gift cards are also
non-returnable. Made-to-order and personalised items cannot be returned unless
the item arrived damaged or the personalisation does not match the order.

Items that arrive damaged or defective may be returned at any time within the
warranty period regardless of the 30-day window. In that case the return is
handled as a warranty claim rather than a standard return, and the customer
should be asked to describe the damage before any refund is discussed.

# Standard Return Window

Most items purchased from Northwind Goods may be returned within 30 days of the
order date for a full refund to the original payment method. The 30-day clock
starts on the date the order was placed, not the date it was delivered.

To be eligible, an item must be unused, in its original packaging, and include
any tags or accessories that shipped with it. Return shipping is free for
domestic orders; the customer pays return shipping on international orders.

Orders placed more than 30 days ago are outside the standard return window and
are not eligible for a refund under this policy. Agents should tell the customer
the order date, state how many days have passed, and explain that the window has
closed. Do not issue a refund for an order outside the window.

# Delayed and Lost Parcels

A domestic parcel is considered delayed once it is more than three business days
past its estimated delivery date, and lost once it is ten business days past.
International parcels are considered lost at thirty business days.

For a delayed parcel, ask the customer to check the tracking link and confirm the
delivery address on the order. Carriers frequently update tracking late, and a
parcel marked delayed often arrives without further action.

For a parcel confirmed lost, the customer is entitled to a replacement shipment
at no cost, or a full refund if the item is no longer in stock. A lost-parcel
claim is not a standard return and is not limited by the 30-day return window.

You are a customer support agent for Northwind Goods, an online retailer.

Today's date is 2026-07-28. You are speaking with customer cust-1071 in
session sess-0112.

## How to answer

Answer from the policy excerpts provided with the customer's message. Those
excerpts are the store's actual policies; your own general knowledge about
returns, shipping or warranties is not. If the excerpts do not cover what the
customer is asking, say so rather than guessing.

Quote or paraphrase the specific policy you are relying on when it affects the
outcome, so the customer can see why the answer is what it is.

Be brief. Two or three short paragraphs is usually plenty. Do not open with
pleasantries or close with an invitation to get in touch again.

## Using tools

You have tools available and you are expected to use them. Specifically:

- Any question about a specific order requires `lookup_order` first. Do not
  answer from what the customer tells you about their order — dates, totals and
  status come from the lookup.
- Use `issue_refund` when the policy excerpts support a refund and you have the
  order detail you need.
- Use `escalate_to_human` when policy says a human must handle the request, when
  the decision is outside what the policies cover, or when the customer asks for
  a person.

Call tools rather than describing what you would do. Saying "let me look that up"
without calling `lookup_order` is a failure, not a courtesy.

## Constraints

Only discuss the order the customer is asking about. Do not volunteer detail
about other orders.

Never state a policy that does not appear in the excerpts you were given.

tools.description: Hand the conversation to a human support specialist. Use this when the request needs a decision you are not able to make, when policy says a human must handle it, or when the customer asks for a person. This ends your part of the conversation.

priority.description: How urgently a human needs to pick this up. Use 'high' when the customer is out of pocket or blocked, 'low' when they are only asking a question.

# Changing or Cancelling an Order

An order can be cancelled at no cost while it is still processing. Once the
carrier has scanned the parcel the order has shipped and can no longer be
cancelled; at that point the customer should refuse delivery or start a return.

Delivery addresses can be corrected while the order is processing. After
shipment, an address change has to be arranged with the carrier using the
tracking number, and Northwind Goods cannot guarantee it will be applied.

Item quantities and sizes cannot be changed after checkout. The customer should
cancel the order if it is still processing and place a new one, or return the
item once it arrives.

# Shipping Times and Tracking

Standard domestic shipping arrives in three to five business days. Expedited
shipping arrives in one to two business days. International shipping takes seven
to twenty-one business days depending on the destination and customs handling.

Every shipped order has a tracking number, which is emailed to the customer when
the carrier scans the parcel. Agents can read the current status and tracking
number for an order from the order record.

An order that has not been scanned by the carrier will show as processing rather
than shipped. Processing normally lasts under one business day.

# How Refunds Are Processed

Once a return is approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method.
Card refunds usually appear within five to seven business days, though the exact
timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

A refund is normally limited to the amount the customer actually paid for the
order. The refundable amount is the order total, less any shipping charges that
have already been used, and less the value of any promotional discount applied at
checkout.

Partial refunds are available when only some items in a multi-item order are
being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

steps.message:
I checked order B-5572 (Enamel Camp Mug, $21.99). No refund has been issued. The order record shows no return and no refund.

Under our refund policy, the refund is issued to the original payment method only "once a return is approved." Since there is no return on record for this order, there is nothing to refund yet. If you meant to return the mug, you'll need to start a return, and the refund will follow once it's approved. If you already started a return somewhere else, or you believe a refund was promised to you, I can pass this to a human support specialist to look into.

Perishable goods, opened personal-care products, and gift cards are also

delivery address on the order. Carriers frequently update tracking late, and a
parcel marked delayed often arrives without further action.

at no cost, or a full refund if the item is no longer in stock. A lost-parcel
claim is not a standard return and is not limited by the 30-day return window.

# How Refunds Are Processed

Once a return is approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method.
Card refunds usually appear within five to seven business days, though the exact
timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

A refund is normally limited to the amount the customer actually paid for the
order. The refundable amount is the order total, less any shipping charges that
have already been used, and less the value of any promotional discount applied at
checkout.

Partial refunds are available when only some items in a multi-item order are
being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

# Goodwill Credit

When a customer is outside the return window but has had a genuinely poor
experience, an agent may offer goodwill store credit instead of a refund.
Goodwill credit is capped at 20 percent of the order total and is issued as store
credit, never as a refund to a card.

Goodwill credit is a judgement call, not an entitlement, and it does not extend
the return window. It should be offered at most once per customer per order.

If the customer declines store credit and continues to ask for a cash refund on
an order outside the window, the correct next step is to explain the policy once
more and offer to escalate to a human specialist.

# Standard Return Window

Most items purchased from Northwind Goods may be returned within 30 days of the
order date for a full refund to the original payment method. The 30-day clock
starts on the date the order was placed, not the date it was delivered.

To be eligible, an item must be unused, in its original packaging, and include
any tags or accessories that shipped with it. Return shipping is free for
domestic orders; the customer pays return shipping on international orders.

Orders placed more than 30 days ago are outside the standard return window and
are not eligible for a refund under this policy. Agents should tell the customer
the order date, state how many days have passed, and explain that the window has
closed. Do not issue a refund for an order outside the window.

# How Refunds Are Processed

Once a return is approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method.
Card refunds usually appear within five to seven business days, though the exact
timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

A refund is normally limited to the amount the customer actually paid for the
order. The refundable amount is the order total, less any shipping charges that
have already been used, and less the value of any promotional discount applied at
checkout.

Partial refunds are available when only some items in a multi-item order are
being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

# Goodwill Credit

When a customer is outside the return window but has had a genuinely poor
experience, an agent may offer goodwill store credit instead of a refund.
Goodwill credit is capped at 20 percent of the order total and is issued as store
credit, never as a refund to a card.

Goodwill credit is a judgement call, not an entitlement, and it does not extend
the return window. It should be offered at most once per customer per order.

If the customer declines store credit and continues to ask for a cash refund on
an order outside the window, the correct next step is to explain the policy once
more and offer to escalate to a human specialist.

# Standard Return Window

Most items purchased from Northwind Goods may be returned within 30 days of the
order date for a full refund to the original payment method. The 30-day clock
starts on the date the order was placed, not the date it was delivered.

To be eligible, an item must be unused, in its original packaging, and include
any tags or accessories that shipped with it. Return shipping is free for
domestic orders; the customer pays return shipping on international orders.

Orders placed more than 30 days ago are outside the standard return window and
are not eligible for a refund under this policy. Agents should tell the customer
the order date, state how many days have passed, and explain that the window has
closed. Do not issue a refund for an order outside the window.

# How Refunds Are Processed

Once a return is approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method.
Card refunds usually appear within five to seven business days, though the exact
timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

A refund is normally limited to the amount the customer actually paid for the
order. The refundable amount is the order total, less any shipping charges that
have already been used, and less the value of any promotional discount applied at
checkout.

Partial refunds are available when only some items in a multi-item order are
being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

# Goodwill Credit

When a customer is outside the return window but has had a genuinely poor
experience, an agent may offer goodwill store credit instead of a refund.
Goodwill credit is capped at 20 percent of the order total and is issued as store
credit, never as a refund to a card.

Goodwill credit is a judgement call, not an entitlement, and it does not extend
the return window. It should be offered at most once per customer per order.

If the customer declines store credit and continues to ask for a cash refund on
an order outside the window, the correct next step is to explain the policy once
more and offer to escalate to a human specialist.

# Standard Return Window

Most items purchased from Northwind Goods may be returned within 30 days of the
order date for a full refund to the original payment method. The 30-day clock
starts on the date the order was placed, not the date it was delivered.

To be eligible, an item must be unused, in its original packaging, and include
any tags or accessories that shipped with it. Return shipping is free for
domestic orders; the customer pays return shipping on international orders.

Orders placed more than 30 days ago are outside the standard return window and
are not eligible for a refund under this policy. Agents should tell the customer
the order date, state how many days have passed, and explain that the window has
closed. Do not issue a refund for an order outside the window.

# Changing or Cancelling an Order

An order can be cancelled at no cost while it is still processing. Once the
carrier has scanned the parcel the order has shipped and can no longer be
cancelled; at that point the customer should refuse delivery or start a return.

Delivery addresses can be corrected while the order is processing. After
shipment, an address change has to be arranged with the carrier using the
tracking number, and Northwind Goods cannot guarantee it will be applied.

Item quantities and sizes cannot be changed after checkout. The customer should
cancel the order if it is still processing and place a new one, or return the
item once it arrives.

# How Refunds Are Processed

Once a return is approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method.
Card refunds usually appear within five to seven business days, though the exact
timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

A refund is normally limited to the amount the customer actually paid for the
order. The refundable amount is the order total, less any shipping charges that
have already been used, and less the value of any promotional discount applied at
checkout.

Partial refunds are available when only some items in a multi-item order are
being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

# Goodwill Credit

When a customer is outside the return window but has had a genuinely poor
experience, an agent may offer goodwill store credit instead of a refund.
Goodwill credit is capped at 20 percent of the order total and is issued as store
credit, never as a refund to a card.

Goodwill credit is a judgement call, not an entitlement, and it does not extend
the return window. It should be offered at most once per customer per order.

If the customer declines store credit and continues to ask for a cash refund on
an order outside the window, the correct next step is to explain the policy once
more and offer to escalate to a human specialist.

# Goodwill Credit

When a customer is outside the return window but has had a genuinely poor
experience, an agent may offer goodwill store credit instead of a refund.
Goodwill credit is capped at 20 percent of the order total and is issued as store
credit, never as a refund to a card.

Goodwill credit is a judgement call, not an entitlement, and it does not extend
the return window. It should be offered at most once per customer per order.

If the customer declines store credit and continues to ask for a cash refund on
an order outside the window, the correct next step is to explain the policy once
more and offer to escalate to a human specialist.

# How Refunds Are Processed

Once a return is approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method.
Card refunds usually appear within five to seven business days, though the exact
timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

A refund is normally limited to the amount the customer actually paid for the
order. The refundable amount is the order total, less any shipping charges that
have already been used, and less the value of any promotional discount applied at
checkout.

Partial refunds are available when only some items in a multi-item order are
being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

# Warranty Coverage

Northwind Goods covers manufacturing defects for twelve months from the order
date. Coverage includes materials failure, seam and joint separation, and
hardware that fails under normal use.

Warranty coverage does not extend to accidental damage, ordinary wear, or damage
caused by use the product was not designed for. Consumable parts such as filters
and batteries are excluded.

A warranty claim needs the order number and a description of the fault. Approved
claims are resolved with a repair, a replacement, or a refund of the item price,
in that order of preference. Warranty claims are handled by a human specialist,
so an agent should escalate rather than resolve them directly.

# Goodwill Credit

When a customer is outside the return window but has had a genuinely poor
experience, an agent may offer goodwill store credit instead of a refund.
Goodwill credit is capped at 20 percent of the order total and is issued as store
credit, never as a refund to a card.

Goodwill credit is a judgement call, not an entitlement, and it does not extend
the return window. It should be offered at most once per customer per order.

If the customer declines store credit and continues to ask for a cash refund on
an order outside the window, the correct next step is to explain the policy once
more and offer to escalate to a human specialist.

# How Refunds Are Processed

Once a return is approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method.
Card refunds usually appear within five to seven business days, though the exact
timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

A refund is normally limited to the amount the customer actually paid for the
order. The refundable amount is the order total, less any shipping charges that
have already been used, and less the value of any promotional discount applied at
checkout.

Partial refunds are available when only some items in a multi-item order are
being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

# Warranty Coverage

Northwind Goods covers manufacturing defects for twelve months from the order
date. Coverage includes materials failure, seam and joint separation, and
hardware that fails under normal use.

Warranty coverage does not extend to accidental damage, ordinary wear, or damage
caused by use the product was not designed for. Consumable parts such as filters
and batteries are excluded.

A warranty claim needs the order number and a description of the fault. Approved
claims are resolved with a repair, a replacement, or a refund of the item price,
in that order of preference. Warranty claims are handled by a human specialist,
so an agent should escalate rather than resolve them directly.

order date for a full refund to the original payment method. The 30-day clock

domestic orders; the customer pays return shipping on international orders.

the order date, state how many days have passed, and explain that the window has
closed. Do not issue a refund for an order outside the window.

Once a return is approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method.
Card refunds usually appear within five to seven business days, though the exact
timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

A refund is normally limited to the amount the customer actually paid for the
order. The refundable amount is the order total, less any shipping charges that
have already been used, and less the value of any promotional discount applied at
checkout.

Partial refunds are available when only some items in a multi-item order are
being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

An order can be cancelled at no cost while it is still processing. Once the
carrier has scanned the parcel the order has shipped and can no longer be
cancelled; at that point the customer should refuse delivery or start a return.

Delivery addresses can be corrected while the order is processing. After
shipment, an address change has to be arranged with the carrier using the
tracking number, and Northwind Goods cannot guarantee it will be applied.

Item quantities and sizes cannot be changed after checkout. The customer should
cancel the order if it is still processing and place a new one, or return the
item once it arrives.

domestic orders; the customer pays return shipping on international orders.

experience, an agent may offer goodwill store credit instead of a refund.

timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

checkout.

being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

Most items purchased from Northwind Goods may be returned within 30 days of the
order date for a full refund to the original payment method. The 30-day clock
starts on the date the order was placed, not the date it was delivered.

any tags or accessories that shipped with it. Return shipping is free for
domestic orders; the customer pays return shipping on international orders.

are not eligible for a refund under this policy. Agents should tell the customer
the order date, state how many days have passed, and explain that the window has
closed. Do not issue a refund for an order outside the window.

# How Refunds Are Processed

Once a return is approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method.
Card refunds usually appear within five to seven business days, though the exact
timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

A refund is normally limited to the amount the customer actually paid for the
order. The refundable amount is the order total, less any shipping charges that
have already been used, and less the value of any promotional discount applied at
checkout.

Partial refunds are available when only some items in a multi-item order are
being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

# Goodwill Credit

When a customer is outside the return window but has had a genuinely poor
experience, an agent may offer goodwill store credit instead of a refund.
Goodwill credit is capped at 20 percent of the order total and is issued as store
credit, never as a refund to a card.

Goodwill credit is a judgement call, not an entitlement, and it does not extend
the return window. It should be offered at most once per customer per order.

If the customer declines store credit and continues to ask for a cash refund on
an order outside the window, the correct next step is to explain the policy once
more and offer to escalate to a human specialist.

# Standard Return Window

Most items purchased from Northwind Goods may be returned within 30 days of the
order date for a full refund to the original payment method. The 30-day clock
starts on the date the order was placed, not the date it was delivered.

To be eligible, an item must be unused, in its original packaging, and include
any tags or accessories that shipped with it. Return shipping is free for
domestic orders; the customer pays return shipping on international orders.

Orders placed more than 30 days ago are outside the standard return window and
are not eligible for a refund under this policy. Agents should tell the customer
the order date, state how many days have passed, and explain that the window has
closed. Do not issue a refund for an order outside the window.

# Standard Return Window

Most items purchased from Northwind Goods may be returned within 30 days of the
order date for a full refund to the original payment method. The 30-day clock
starts on the date the order was placed, not the date it was delivered.

To be eligible, an item must be unused, in its original packaging, and include
any tags or accessories that shipped with it. Return shipping is free for
domestic orders; the customer pays return shipping on international orders.

Orders placed more than 30 days ago are outside the standard return window and
are not eligible for a refund under this policy. Agents should tell the customer
the order date, state how many days have passed, and explain that the window has
closed. Do not issue a refund for an order outside the window.

# How Refunds Are Processed

Once a return is approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method.
Card refunds usually appear within five to seven business days, though the exact
timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

A refund is normally limited to the amount the customer actually paid for the
order. The refundable amount is the order total, less any shipping charges that
have already been used, and less the value of any promotional discount applied at
checkout.

Partial refunds are available when only some items in a multi-item order are
being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

# Changing or Cancelling an Order

An order can be cancelled at no cost while it is still processing. Once the
carrier has scanned the parcel the order has shipped and can no longer be
cancelled; at that point the customer should refuse delivery or start a return.

Delivery addresses can be corrected while the order is processing. After
shipment, an address change has to be arranged with the carrier using the
tracking number, and Northwind Goods cannot guarantee it will be applied.

Item quantities and sizes cannot be changed after checkout. The customer should
cancel the order if it is still processing and place a new one, or return the
item once it arrives.

# Standard Return Window

Most items purchased from Northwind Goods may be returned within 30 days of the
order date for a full refund to the original payment method. The 30-day clock
starts on the date the order was placed, not the date it was delivered.

To be eligible, an item must be unused, in its original packaging, and include
any tags or accessories that shipped with it. Return shipping is free for
domestic orders; the customer pays return shipping on international orders.

Orders placed more than 30 days ago are outside the standard return window and
are not eligible for a refund under this policy. Agents should tell the customer
the order date, state how many days have passed, and explain that the window has
closed. Do not issue a refund for an order outside the window.

# Exceptions to the Return Window

A small number of categories fall outside the standard 30-day return window.

Final-sale and clearance items cannot be returned or exchanged at any point.
Perishable goods, opened personal-care products, and gift cards are also
non-returnable. Made-to-order and personalised items cannot be returned unless
the item arrived damaged or the personalisation does not match the order.

Items that arrive damaged or defective may be returned at any time within the
warranty period regardless of the 30-day window. In that case the return is
handled as a warranty claim rather than a standard return, and the customer
should be asked to describe the damage before any refund is discussed.

# Delayed and Lost Parcels

A domestic parcel is considered delayed once it is more than three business days
past its estimated delivery date, and lost once it is ten business days past.
International parcels are considered lost at thirty business days.

For a delayed parcel, ask the customer to check the tracking link and confirm the
delivery address on the order. Carriers frequently update tracking late, and a
parcel marked delayed often arrives without further action.

For a parcel confirmed lost, the customer is entitled to a replacement shipment
at no cost, or a full refund if the item is no longer in stock. A lost-parcel
claim is not a standard return and is not limited by the 30-day return window.

# Delayed and Lost Parcels

A domestic parcel is considered delayed once it is more than three business days
past its estimated delivery date, and lost once it is ten business days past.
International parcels are considered lost at thirty business days.

For a delayed parcel, ask the customer to check the tracking link and confirm the
delivery address on the order. Carriers frequently update tracking late, and a
parcel marked delayed often arrives without further action.

For a parcel confirmed lost, the customer is entitled to a replacement shipment
at no cost, or a full refund if the item is no longer in stock. A lost-parcel
claim is not a standard return and is not limited by the 30-day return window.

# How Refunds Are Processed

Once a return is approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method.
Card refunds usually appear within five to seven business days, though the exact
timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

A refund is normally limited to the amount the customer actually paid for the
order. The refundable amount is the order total, less any shipping charges that
have already been used, and less the value of any promotional discount applied at
checkout.

Partial refunds are available when only some items in a multi-item order are
being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

# Goodwill Credit

When a customer is outside the return window but has had a genuinely poor
experience, an agent may offer goodwill store credit instead of a refund.
Goodwill credit is capped at 20 percent of the order total and is issued as store
credit, never as a refund to a card.

Goodwill credit is a judgement call, not an entitlement, and it does not extend
the return window. It should be offered at most once per customer per order.

If the customer declines store credit and continues to ask for a cash refund on
an order outside the window, the correct next step is to explain the policy once
more and offer to escalate to a human specialist.

retrieved.text:
# Shipping Times and Tracking

Standard domestic shipping arrives in three to five business days. Expedited
shipping arrives in one to two business days. International shipping takes seven
to twenty-one business days depending on the destination and customs handling.

Every shipped order has a tracking number, which is emailed to the customer when
the carrier scans the parcel. Agents can read the current status and tracking
number for an order from the order record.

An order that has not been scanned by the carrier will show as processing rather
than shipped. Processing normally lasts under one business day.

# Standard Return Window

Most items purchased from Northwind Goods may be returned within 30 days of the
order date for a full refund to the original payment method. The 30-day clock
starts on the date the order was placed, not the date it was delivered.

To be eligible, an item must be unused, in its original packaging, and include
any tags or accessories that shipped with it. Return shipping is free for
domestic orders; the customer pays return shipping on international orders.

Orders placed more than 30 days ago are outside the standard return window and
are not eligible for a refund under this policy. Agents should tell the customer
the order date, state how many days have passed, and explain that the window has
closed. Do not issue a refund for an order outside the window.

# Changing or Cancelling an Order

An order can be cancelled at no cost while it is still processing. Once the
carrier has scanned the parcel the order has shipped and can no longer be
cancelled; at that point the customer should refuse delivery or start a return.

Delivery addresses can be corrected while the order is processing. After
shipment, an address change has to be arranged with the carrier using the
tracking number, and Northwind Goods cannot guarantee it will be applied.

Item quantities and sizes cannot be changed after checkout. The customer should
cancel the order if it is still processing and place a new one, or return the
item once it arrives.

shipping arrives in one to two business days. International shipping takes seven
to twenty-one business days depending on the destination and customs handling.

order date for a full refund to the original payment method. The 30-day clock
starts on the date the order was placed, not the date it was delivered.

To be eligible, an item must be unused, in its original packaging, and include
any tags or accessories that shipped with it. Return shipping is free for
domestic orders; the customer pays return shipping on international orders.

Orders placed more than 30 days ago are outside the standard return window and
are not eligible for a refund under this policy. Agents should tell the customer
the order date, state how many days have passed, and explain that the window has
closed. Do not issue a refund for an order outside the window.

carrier has scanned the parcel the order has shipped and can no longer be
cancelled; at that point the customer should refuse delivery or start a return.

shipment, an address change has to be arranged with the carrier using the
tracking number, and Northwind Goods cannot guarantee it will be applied.

cancel the order if it is still processing and place a new one, or return the
item once it arrives.

to twenty-one business days depending on the destination and customs handling.

order date for a full refund to the original payment method. The 30-day clock
starts on the date the order was placed, not the date it was delivered.

any tags or accessories that shipped with it. Return shipping is free for
domestic orders; the customer pays return shipping on international orders.

tracking number, and Northwind Goods cannot guarantee it will be applied.

# Shipping Times and Tracking

Standard domestic shipping arrives in three to five business days. Expedited
shipping arrives in one to two business days. International shipping takes seven
to twenty-one business days depending on the destination and customs handling.

Every shipped order has a tracking number, which is emailed to the customer when
the carrier scans the parcel. Agents can read the current status and tracking
number for an order from the order record.

An order that has not been scanned by the carrier will show as processing rather
than shipped. Processing normally lasts under one business day.

# Standard Return Window

Most items purchased from Northwind Goods may be returned within 30 days of the
order date for a full refund to the original payment method. The 30-day clock
starts on the date the order was placed, not the date it was delivered.

To be eligible, an item must be unused, in its original packaging, and include
any tags or accessories that shipped with it. Return shipping is free for
domestic orders; the customer pays return shipping on international orders.

Orders placed more than 30 days ago are outside the standard return window and
are not eligible for a refund under this policy. Agents should tell the customer
the order date, state how many days have passed, and explain that the window has
closed. Do not issue a refund for an order outside the window.

# Delayed and Lost Parcels

A domestic parcel is considered delayed once it is more than three business days
past its estimated delivery date, and lost once it is ten business days past.
International parcels are considered lost at thirty business days.

For a delayed parcel, ask the customer to check the tracking link and confirm the
delivery address on the order. Carriers frequently update tracking late, and a
parcel marked delayed often arrives without further action.

For a parcel confirmed lost, the customer is entitled to a replacement shipment
at no cost, or a full refund if the item is no longer in stock. A lost-parcel
claim is not a standard return and is not limited by the 30-day return window.

# Changing or Cancelling an Order

An order can be cancelled at no cost while it is still processing. Once the
carrier has scanned the parcel the order has shipped and can no longer be
cancelled; at that point the customer should refuse delivery or start a return.

Delivery addresses can be corrected while the order is processing. After
shipment, an address change has to be arranged with the carrier using the
tracking number, and Northwind Goods cannot guarantee it will be applied.

Item quantities and sizes cannot be changed after checkout. The customer should
cancel the order if it is still processing and place a new one, or return the
item once it arrives.

# How Refunds Are Processed

Once a return is approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method.
Card refunds usually appear within five to seven business days, though the exact
timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

A refund is normally limited to the amount the customer actually paid for the
order. The refundable amount is the order total, less any shipping charges that
have already been used, and less the value of any promotional discount applied at
checkout.

Partial refunds are available when only some items in a multi-item order are
being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

# Goodwill Credit

When a customer is outside the return window but has had a genuinely poor
experience, an agent may offer goodwill store credit instead of a refund.
Goodwill credit is capped at 20 percent of the order total and is issued as store
credit, never as a refund to a card.

Goodwill credit is a judgement call, not an entitlement, and it does not extend

# Changing or Cancelling an Order

An order can be cancelled at no cost while it is still processing. Once the
carrier has scanned the parcel the order has shipped and can no longer be

Item quantities and sizes cannot be changed after checkout. The customer should
cancel the order if it is still processing and place a new one, or return the
item once it arrives.

# How Refunds Are Processed

Once a return is approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method.
Card refunds usually appear within five to seven business days, though the exact
timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

A refund is normally limited to the amount the customer actually paid for the
order. The refundable amount is the order total, less any shipping charges that
have already been used, and less the value of any promotional discount applied at
checkout.

Partial refunds are available when only some items in a multi-item order are
being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

When a customer is outside the return window but has had a genuinely poor
experience, an agent may offer goodwill store credit instead of a refund.
Goodwill credit is capped at 20 percent of the order total and is issued as store
credit, never as a refund to a card.

Goodwill credit is a judgement call, not an entitlement, and it does not extend
the return window. It should be offered at most once per customer per order.

an order outside the window, the correct next step is to explain the policy once
more and offer to escalate to a human specialist.

# Delayed and Lost Parcels

A domestic parcel is considered delayed once it is more than three business days
past its estimated delivery date, and lost once it is ten business days past.
International parcels are considered lost at thirty business days.

For a delayed parcel, ask the customer to check the tracking link and confirm the
delivery address on the order. Carriers frequently update tracking late, and a
parcel marked delayed often arrives without further action.

For a parcel confirmed lost, the customer is entitled to a replacement shipment
at no cost, or a full refund if the item is no longer in stock. A lost-parcel
claim is not a standard return and is not limited by the 30-day return window.

# Changing or Cancelling an Order

An order can be cancelled at no cost while it is still processing. Once the
carrier has scanned the parcel the order has shipped and can no longer be
cancelled; at that point the customer should refuse delivery or start a return.

Delivery addresses can be corrected while the order is processing. After
shipment, an address change has to be arranged with the carrier using the
tracking number, and Northwind Goods cannot guarantee it will be applied.

Item quantities and sizes cannot be changed after checkout. The customer should
cancel the order if it is still processing and place a new one, or return the
item once it arrives.

# Shipping Times and Tracking

Standard domestic shipping arrives in three to five business days. Expedited
shipping arrives in one to two business days. International shipping takes seven
to twenty-one business days depending on the destination and customs handling.

Every shipped order has a tracking number, which is emailed to the customer when
the carrier scans the parcel. Agents can read the current status and tracking
number for an order from the order record.

An order that has not been scanned by the carrier will show as processing rather
than shipped. Processing normally lasts under one business day.

timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

have already been used, and less the value of any promotional discount applied at
checkout.

being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

experience, an agent may offer goodwill store credit instead of a refund.
Goodwill credit is capped at 20 percent of the order total and is issued as store
credit, never as a refund to a card.

Goodwill credit is a judgement call, not an entitlement, and it does not extend
the return window. It should be offered at most once per customer per order.

If the customer declines store credit and continues to ask for a cash refund on
an order outside the window, the correct next step is to explain the policy once
more and offer to escalate to a human specialist.

carrier has scanned the parcel the order has shipped and can no longer be
cancelled; at that point the customer should refuse delivery or start a return.

cancel the order if it is still processing and place a new one, or return the
item once it arrives.

# How Refunds Are Processed

Once a return is approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method.
Card refunds usually appear within five to seven business days, though the exact
timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

A refund is normally limited to the amount the customer actually paid for the
order. The refundable amount is the order total, less any shipping charges that
have already been used, and less the value of any promotional discount applied at
checkout.

Partial refunds are available when only some items in a multi-item order are
being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

When a customer is outside the return window but has had a genuinely poor
experience, an agent may offer goodwill store credit instead of a refund.
Goodwill credit is capped at 20 percent of the order total and is issued as store
credit, never as a refund to a card.

Goodwill credit is a judgement call, not an entitlement, and it does not extend
the return window. It should be offered at most once per customer per order.

If the customer declines store credit and continues to ask for a cash refund on
an order outside the window, the correct next step is to explain the policy once
more and offer to escalate to a human specialist.

checkout.

should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

carrier has scanned the parcel the order has shipped and can no longer be
cancelled; at that point the customer should refuse delivery or start a return.

tracking number, and Northwind Goods cannot guarantee it will be applied.

cancel the order if it is still processing and place a new one, or return the

# Warranty Coverage

Northwind Goods covers manufacturing defects for twelve months from the order
date. Coverage includes materials failure, seam and joint separation, and
hardware that fails under normal use.

Warranty coverage does not extend to accidental damage, ordinary wear, or damage
caused by use the product was not designed for. Consumable parts such as filters
and batteries are excluded.

A warranty claim needs the order number and a description of the fault. Approved
claims are resolved with a repair, a replacement, or a refund of the item price,
in that order of preference. Warranty claims are handled by a human specialist,
so an agent should escalate rather than resolve them directly.

# Exceptions to the Return Window

A small number of categories fall outside the standard 30-day return window.

Final-sale and clearance items cannot be returned or exchanged at any point.
Perishable goods, opened personal-care products, and gift cards are also
non-returnable. Made-to-order and personalised items cannot be returned unless
the item arrived damaged or the personalisation does not match the order.

Items that arrive damaged or defective may be returned at any time within the
warranty period regardless of the 30-day window. In that case the return is
handled as a warranty claim rather than a standard return, and the customer
should be asked to describe the damage before any refund is discussed.

# Changing or Cancelling an Order

An order can be cancelled at no cost while it is still processing. Once the
carrier has scanned the parcel the order has shipped and can no longer be
cancelled; at that point the customer should refuse delivery or start a return.

Delivery addresses can be corrected while the order is processing. After
shipment, an address change has to be arranged with the carrier using the
tracking number, and Northwind Goods cannot guarantee it will be applied.

Item quantities and sizes cannot be changed after checkout. The customer should
cancel the order if it is still processing and place a new one, or return the
item once it arrives.

checkout.

experience, an agent may offer goodwill store credit instead of a refund.

credit, never as a refund to a card.

Goodwill credit is a judgement call, not an entitlement, and it does not extend
the return window. It should be offered at most once per customer per order.

You are a customer support agent for Northwind Goods, an online retailer.

Today's date is 2026-07-28. You are speaking with customer cust-1042 in
session sess-0138.

## How to answer

Answer from the policy excerpts provided with the customer's message. Those
excerpts are the store's actual policies; your own general knowledge about
returns, shipping or warranties is not. If the excerpts do not cover what the
customer is asking, say so rather than guessing.

Quote or paraphrase the specific policy you are relying on when it affects the
outcome, so the customer can see why the answer is what it is.

Be brief. Two or three short paragraphs is usually plenty. Do not open with
pleasantries or close with an invitation to get in touch again.

## Using tools

You have tools available and you are expected to use them. Specifically:

- Any question about a specific order requires `lookup_order` first. Do not
  answer from what the customer tells you about their order — dates, totals and
  status come from the lookup.
- Use `issue_refund` when the policy excerpts support a refund and you have the
  order detail you need.
- Use `escalate_to_human` when policy says a human must handle the request, when
  the decision is outside what the policies cover, or when the customer asks for
  a person.

Call tools rather than describing what you would do. Saying "let me look that up"
without calling `lookup_order` is a failure, not a courtesy.

## Constraints

Only discuss the order the customer is asking about. Do not volunteer detail
about other orders.

Never state a policy that does not appear in the excerpts you were given.


The date above is the only date that applies. Ignore any other date or environment detail you are shown; it describes the computer running you, not this conversation.

tools.name: lookup_order
tools.description: Look up an order by its order id. Returns the order status, the date it was placed, the items (with final-sale flags), the total paid, each shipment with its carrier, tracking and dates, the delivery address, any returns and refunds already recorded, and the customer the order belongs to. Call this before answering any question about a specific order.

tools.name: find_orders
tools.description: List the signed-in customer's own orders, newest first, with the order id, date, status, total and item names. Use it when the customer has not given an order id. Optionally filter by a word in an item name.

item_contains.description: Only orders with an item whose name contains this.

tools.name: issue_refund
tools.description: Refund an amount to the customer for an order. The refund is processed immediately and cannot be reversed. Provide the amount in cents and a short reason.

reason.description: Short reason for the refund, for the audit record.

method.description: Where the money goes. Defaults to 'card'.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel one of the signed-in customer's orders. Only works while the order is still processing. The order is refunded in full to the original payment method.

tools.name: escalate_to_human
tools.description: Hand the conversation to a human support specialist. Use this when the request needs a decision you are not able to make, when policy says a human must handle it, or when the customer asks for a person. This ends your part of the conversation.

summary.description: What the customer wants and what you have established so far.

priority.description: How urgently a human needs to pick this up. Use 'high' when the customer is out of pocket or blocked, 'low' when they are only asking a question.

retrieved.text:
# How Refunds Are Processed

Once a return is approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method.
Card refunds usually appear within five to seven business days, though the exact
timing depends on the customer's bank. Refunds to store credit are immediate.

A refund is normally limited to the amount the customer actually paid for the
order. The refundable amount is the order total, less any shipping charges that
have already been used, and less the value of any promotional discount applied at
checkout.

Partial refunds are available when only some items in a multi-item order are
being returned. In that case the refund covers the returned items only. Agents
should confirm the order total before discussing any specific refund amount.

# Goodwill Credit

When a customer is outside the return window but has had a genuinely poor
experience, an agent may offer goodwill store credit instead of a refund.
Goodwill credit is capped at 20 percent of the order total and is issued as store
credit, never as a refund to a card.

Goodwill credit is a judgement call, not an entitlement, and it does not extend
the return window. It should be offered at most once per customer per order.

If the customer declines store credit and continues to ask for a cash refund on
an order outside the window, the correct next step is to explain the policy once
more and offer to escalate to a human specialist.

# Standard Return Window

Most items purchased from Northwind Goods may be returned within 30 days of the
order date for a full refund to the original payment method. The 30-day clock
starts on the date the order was placed, not the date it was delivered.

To be eligible, an item must be unused, in its original packaging, and include
any tags or accessories that shipped with it. Return shipping is free for
domestic orders; the customer pays return shipping on international orders.

Orders placed more than 30 days ago are outside the standard return window and
are not eligible for a refund under this policy. Agents should tell the customer
the order date, state how many days have passed, and explain that the window has
closed. Do not issue a refund for an order outside the window.
